plugins.name: bestmentor
plugins.description: BestMentor: a ready-made knowledge base of Alexey Krol's book «Теория каст и ролей» (Theory of Castes and Roles). Claude answers from the book with chapter references and quotes, and says so when the book doesn't cover a question. Works in Chat, Cowork and Code in the Claude app.

plugins.name: pen
plugins.description: Post editor for non-native English speakers: proofreads drafts and transcripts in any language, translates the meaning into American English, and delivers a thread-ready X version and a LinkedIn version within 3,000 characters.
